title: fix: revert Level 3 deduplication to align with MVP 7-day simulation spec
body:
The previously added Level 3 deduplication (`metric_name + anomaly_type` cross-day suppression) conflicted with the MVP design requirement that each day's anomaly detection creates its own ticket (2 anomaly types × 7 days = 14 tickets). Because `canonical_key` embeds a date-based `period_bucket`, cross-day tickets are intentionally distinct by design — Level 1 already prevents same-day/same-period duplicates.

## Changes

- **`TicketDeduplicator` — remove Level 3**
  - Removed the `metric_name + anomaly_type` cross-day duplicate suppression block
  - Level 1 (`canonical_key` exact match) and Level 2 (`source_type + source_id + metric_name + anomaly_type`) remain unchanged
  - Updated header comment to clarify that cross-day tickets are expected per MVP design

- **`ticket_deduplicator_spec.rb` — remove Level 3 coverage**
  - Removed the three Level 3 test cases that validated cross-day suppression behaviour
